title: Introducing Stretch | Boston Dynamics
summary: Boston Dynamics introduces Stretch, a prototype robot that moves boxes in warehouses and distribution centers. Its mobile base lets it unload trucks, build pallets and assemble orders.
why: HN links it as the official demo showing what Stretch actually does, though some commenters point out its limits, such as picking boxes from one side.
